newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs end down on technicals, Ecuador worries.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs end down on technicals, Ecuador worries.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed down Thursday in a technical correction that was exaggerated due to investor concern about regional stability following civil unrest in neighboring Ecuador, brokers said.
They added there was no obvious trend for Friday's session as players were reacting to unpredictable events in Ecuador.

Thursday, the General Index .IGRA fell 1.1 percent to 1,561.4 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL rose 1.23 percent to 2,240.0 points. In a total of 1,326 trades, 34 stocks fell, 31 remained unchanged and 20 rose. Volume was 25.1 million soles ($9.5 million).
The market "corrected a little because of the rises in previous days, but this combined with a fall due to the problem that Ecuador is living through," Pablo Navarro of local brokerage Fortuna said.

A wave of public protests at government economic reforms has hit Ecuador this week and prompted the country's Congress to prepare a debate on the possibility of ousting President Abdala Bucaram from power.
Among leaders, Telefonica del Peru fell 1.69 percent to 5.81 soles in volume of 874,065 shares.

The electricity utility Edegel dropped 1.59 percent to 1.24 soles in volume of 551,070 shares, while the country's largest brewery Backus y Jonhston fell 4.26 percent to 2.25 soles in volume of 214,335 shares.
